bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement.
evidence: each specimen own config.json (nested text_config/llm_cfg/decoder when that is the decoder body); dtype from torch_dtype/dtype or a floating safetensors HEADER, never a payload
not_measured: GPU-resident KV, quantized cache dtypes other than the config dtype, indexer caches, vision-encoder KV during prefills
odyssey_ledger_axes_unchanged: G034 ledger axes stay anatomy/ebpw/gpu/cpu/tps/nr_candidate/nx_disposition. state is a campaign-Pareto axis, not an eighth Odyssey axis; adding it would change the 392-count G009 contract.
refusal_rule: missing field is a named key plus the path read; unknown is not a refusal
what_is_measured: Bytes of persistent decode state. state_bytes_per_token is the comparable Pareto value (lower is better): KV/MLA bytes added per generated token while the cache is still growing; 0 for recurrent/DeltaNet/Mamba layers. state_bytes_fixed is mixer state that does not grow with position. state_bytes_at_ctx evaluates the same at max_position_embeddings, bounded by sliding_window when the config declares one that is smaller than context.
